testCases.label: Test when the first array comes before the second (Returns -1)
testCases.description: Verifies that comparing 'cat' to 'dog' returns -1, indicating 'cat' is lexicographically smaller.

testCases.label: Test when the first array comes after the second (Returns 1)
testCases.description: Verifies that comparing 'mouse' to 'dog' returns 1, indicating 'mouse' is lexicographically larger.

testCases.label: Test when both arrays are equal (Returns 0)
testCases.description: Verifies that comparing 'mouse' to 'mouse' returns 0, indicating equality.

testCases.label: Test difference check after a common prefix (Returns 1)
testCases.description: Verifies that comparing 'dot' to 'dog' returns 1, as 'dot' is lexicographically larger after checking the common 'do' prefix.
